note: No public queryable zoning district service found for Sequoyah County, OK (FIPS 40135). County GIS portals are third-party guides; the county assessor's interactive map (actdatascout.com) returned a WAF error and no zoning layer is named; the county open-data service (Sequoyah_County_Data FeatureServer) has only municipal, legislative, hydrology and census layers. The City of Sallisaw publishes its zoning map only as a scanned PDF (DocumentCenter/View/1597), so it is viewer-only. Commercial parcel vendors (Regrid, etc.) carry zoning codes but are paywalled and not official.
